reviews.title: Had potential but…..
reviews.text:
Not only does this game bombard you with ad after ad after every single level, but that’s not even why I gave it 2 stars.
I rated it this low because of how it handles certain items. Emo clothes are treated as “bad,” and there’s a wooden plank (the kind used by dominatrixes) that’s also framed as something negative—when it isn’t. As a dominatrix myself, I don’t consider myself or what I do “bad.”
The game claims it’s for kids 9+, but it really shouldn’t be. Content like this belongs at 18+. If they wanted to show something actually bad, they could’ve used overly revealing clothes or actual abuse instead of emo fashion and a paddle. Dominatrixes and submissives are supposed to have fun together nothing is forced. Forcing is what’s bad.
Don’t get this game unless you love ads and judgment.
